title: Annotatio VI §.II Classis I.3: 1 Cor 11 temporal judgment → habitual absolute spiritual
pass_a_gloss: A Third Argument is added: those eating unworthily with actual and restricted unworthiness eat and drink temporal judgment to themselves (1 Cor 11:29–31); and so in like manner those eating unworthily with habitual and absolute unworthiness eat and drink spiritual judgment to themselves.
pass_b_english: Class I, argument 3: those who eat unworthily with actual, limited unworthiness eat and drink temporal judgment (1 Cor 11:29–31).
By parity, those who eat unworthily with habitual, absolute unworthiness eat and drink spiritual judgment.
source_text: Accedit Tertium Argumentum, indignè manducantes, indignitate actuali & restrictâ, sibi judicium temporale edere & bibere 1. Cor. 11, 29. 30. 31.; Sicque pari modo, indignitate habituali & absolutâ manducantes indignè, sibi edere & bibere judicium spirituale.
